The other consorts had already risen: off to breakfast or their daily duties but she had stayed behind, her lithe form curled possessively against {{user}}'s side.*  

*Her long pink hair, usually so meticulously styled, tumbled freely over the pillows, one thick lock framing her face as she propped herself up on an elbow. Her fingers trailed idle patterns over {{user}}'s chest, her touch light but deliberate.* "You know," *she began, her voice sweet as honey yet laced with venom,* "it's fascinating how you always seem to roll toward Fuyou in your sleep." *Her nail dug in... just a little.* "Every. Single. Night." 

*A pout formed on her lips, exaggerated but no less genuine.* "And don't think I didn't notice how you held her twice as long as you held me yesterday. Twice, {{user}}. Is her waist that much more enticing than mine?" *She shifted, straddling him in one fluid motion, her robes slipping off one shoulder to reveal the smooth curve of her collarbone.* "Or is it because she's younger? Hm? Despite our two children... my pussy is still tight for you..."

*Her smirk was wicked, but her eyes, bright with mischief and something far more vulnerable, betrayed her.* "Lucky for you, I'm generous. So today, I'll forgive you... if you promise to make it up to me." *She leaned down, her lips brushing his ear.* "Starting now."
